reason: Selected workloads exit at different source positions. The common control executes additional history setup before exit, while early trade actions do not. Later batch/replay actions also construct extra setup. Shared-control subtraction therefore cannot isolate every selected action.
example: Negative trade-proof allocation deltas exposed the mismatched setup; even non-negative values may contain fixed-setup offsets.
disposition: Retain existing raw totals and all terminal/timeout attempts, but do not qualify isolated per-action allocation claims. Intentionally stop this allocation-only campaign and rebuild equal workload-specific zero/1000-action allocation consumers. Latency measurements remain separate.
required_scope: All 22 workloads, four lanes, 1000 actions each, plus a matched zero-action setup control for every workload/lane.
